latest.notes: Overnight handoff. The on-air log now rolls into the next day automatically at midnight (it was pinned to the date the app launched — the root cause of the overnight stalls). If tomorrow still has no log past a configurable hour (Settings > Scheduling > Next-Day Log, default 9 PM), the app auto-generates it from the schedule (full day + commercials). An orange 'No log tomorrow' notice appears above Settings whenever tomorrow's log is missing, so you can build it yourself first. The rollover switches only at an element boundary, never mid-song.
